article_content: By Michael Zennie, Meghan Keneally, and David McCormack. PUBLISHED: 16:48 EST, 25 December 2013 | UPDATED: 09:53 EST, 27 December 2013. Disgraced former New York Governor Eliot Spitzer and his new girlfriend Lis Smith enjoyed a relaxing family Christmas with her parents. However, their domestic bliss may soon be disrupted as Smith faces potential job loss due to their relationship. Spitzer, 54, and his long-suffering wife Silda announced their separation on Christmas Eve, just days after photos emerged of Spitzer leaving Smith's Soho apartment. Smith, 31, serves as a spokesperson for mayor-elect Bill de Blasio. Today, a source denied that senior de Blasio aides are interviewing replacements for the communications director position. The source told MailOnline: 'Lis was part of de Blasio's transition team, and her future role is yet to be determined. Everything is in flux.' Smith played a crucial role in de Blasio's successful mayoral campaign, but her relationship with Spitzer has cast a shadow over her career. Her future is uncertain as de Blasio has not decided whether to retain her. He reportedly feels blindsided by the affair, according to The New York Post. There is tension between de Blasio and Spitzer. In August, de Blasio criticized Spitzer, calling him a 'child of the elite' and praising his rival Scott Stringer for his integrity. The media coverage of the affair prompted Spitzer and Silda to announce their separation on Christmas Eve. On Christmas Day, Smith introduced Spitzer to her parents at their home in Bronxville. Despite the cold weather, Smith wore a sleeveless dress without tights or a jacket. Spitzer, dressed casually, waved to photographers before entering the house. Rumors of the Spitzers' marital troubles have circulated for some time, but they formally announced their separation on Christmas Eve. 'We regret that our marital relationship has come to an end and we have agreed not to make any further public statements on this subject,' said Spitzer family spokeswoman Lisa Linden. It is unclear whether the couple is already divorced or planning to divorce. Lis Smith's late-night meetings with Spitzer may have jeopardized her job. Silda Spitzer stood by her husband during his prostitution scandal in 2008, but they have been living apart. Spitzer has focused on his family's real estate business since his failed bid for New York City Controller. Smith, who joined de Blasio's team after Spitzer's primary loss, was a frontrunner for the press secretary position before the relationship was revealed. A former colleague praised Smith's professionalism, stating that her personal life should not overshadow her accomplishments. Spitzer's past scandals, including his involvement with a prostitution ring, have also resurfaced in the media. A friend of the couple defended their relationship, saying it began after Spitzer and Silda were living separately and was not a secret. The friend described Smith as a highly respected professional dealing well with the situation.

Bivši guverner New Yorka Eliot Spitzer i njegova nova djevojka Lis Smith uživali su u opuštajućem obiteljskom Božiću s njezinim roditeljima. Spitzer, 54, i njegova dugotrpna supruga Silda najavili su razvod na Badnjak, samo nekoliko dana nakon što su se pojavile fotografije Spitzera kako napušta Smithin stan u Sohou. Smith, 31, radi kao glasnogovornica za gradonačelnika Billa de Blasija. Danas je izvor demantirao da viši de Blasijevi suradnici traže zamjenu za poziciju direktora za komunikacije. Izvor je rekao MailOnlineu: 'Lis je bila dio de Blasijevog prijelaznog tima, a njezina buduća uloga još nije određena. Sve je u tijeku.' Smith je odigrala ključnu ulogu u de Blasijevoj uspješnoj gradonačelničkoj kampanji, ali njena veza sa Spitzerom baca sjenku na njezinu karijeru. Njezina budućnost je neizvjesna jer de Blasio još nije odlučio hoće li je zadržati. Prema The New York Postu, navodno se osjeća iznevjerenim zbog afere. Postoji napetost između de Blasija i Spitzera. U kolovozu je de Blasio kritizirao Spitzera, nazvavši ga 'djetetom elite' i hvaleći njegovog rivala Scotta Stringera zbog njegovog integriteta. Medijsko praćenje afere potaknulo je Spitzera i Sildu da najave razvod na Badnjak. Na Božić, Smith je predstavila Spitzera svojim roditeljima u njihovom domu u Bronxvilleu. Unatoč hladnom vremenu, Smith je nosila haljinu bez hulahopki ili jakne. Spitzer, odjeven neformalno, mahnuo je fotoreporterima prije ulaska u kuću. Glasine o bračnim problemima Spitzera kružile su neko vrijeme, ali službeno su najavili razvod na Badnjak. 'Žalimo što je naš brak propao i dogovorili smo se da više nećemo davati izjave o toj temi', rekla je glasnogovornica obitelji Spitzer, Lisa Linden. Nije jasno je li par već razveden ili planiraju razvod. Lis Smith sastanci s kasnim terminima sa Spitzerom mogli bi ugroziti njezin posao. Silda Spitzer stajala je uz svog muža tijekom skandala s prostitucijom 2008., ali živjeli su odvojeno. Spitzer se usredotočio na obiteljski posao s nekretninama nakon neuspjeha na izborima za gradskog kontrolora New Yorka. Smith, koja se pridružila de Blasijevom timu nakon Spitzerovog poraza na primarnim izborima, bila je favorit za mjesto tajnice za tisak prije nego što je veza otkrivena. Bivši kolega pohvalio je Smithin profesionalizam, rekavši da njezin privatni život ne bi trebao zasjeniti njezina postignuća. Spitzerovi prošli skandali, uključujući upletenost u prsten za prostituciju, također su ponovno izašli u medije. Prijatelj para branio je njihovu vezu, rekavši da je započela nakon što su Spitzer i Silda živjeli odvojeno i da to nije bila tajna. Prijatelj je opisao Smith kao visoko cijenjenu profesionalnu osobu koja se dobro nosi sa situacijom.

article_content: Newsflash: The melting of Antarctic ice sheets is set to raise sea levels by at least 10 feet over the next few centuries, endangering many coastal communities and displacing millions. But why should we care? This seems like a problem for future generations, not us. After all, who knows if there will even be people around by then? And even if there are, do we owe them anything? The predictions come from two scientific teams who used different methods to study various parts of Antarctica. Eric Rignot, a glaciologist from the University of California, Irvine, led one of the teams. He stated that a significant portion of the West Antarctic ice sheet has entered an irreversible state of retreat. Since the early 1990s, his team has observed shrinkage of 10 to 35 kilometers in several glaciers, which are also thinning. The primary cause of the melting is the warming due to increased carbon dioxide from burning fossil fuels. The ozone hole, though unrelated to greenhouse gases, might also be playing a role by intensifying winds that draw warm waters to the surface, eroding the ice. While sea level rise has mostly been due to the thermal expansion of seawater, melting land ice will soon have a major impact. Ian Joughin, leader of the other research team, confirmed that the ice sheet's collapse is inevitable but will occur slowly over centuries. John H. Mercer of Ohio State University first predicted this scenario back in 1978. Though he didn't live to see it, his predictions are now becoming a reality. Meanwhile, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) warns that sea levels could rise by up to 3 feet within this century, affecting many of us and our children. The article also highlights current issues like flooding in low-lying areas worldwide and the political gridlock preventing meaningful action on climate change. It raises questions about our moral responsibility to future generations and the lack of progress in transitioning to clean energy. Despite knowing the risks for decades, there has been little progress. Technology has advanced, but it hasn't been widely adopted due to denial, inertia, and the influence of big-energy lobbying. Globally, there is a lack of united effort to stabilize the climate and promote clean energy. The article concludes with a sense of resignation, suggesting that humanity may not be capable of addressing the problems we've created.
translated_content: Vijesti: Topljenje antarktičkih ledenih ploča uzrokovat će porast razine mora za najmanje 10 stopa tijekom sljedećih nekoliko stoljeća, ugrožavajući mnoge obalne zajednice i raseljavajući milijune ljudi. Ali zašto bi nas to trebalo brinuti? Ovo izgleda kao problem za buduće generacije, a ne za nas. Tko zna hoće li čak i biti ljudi tada? I ako budu, dugujemo li im išta? Predviđanja dolaze od dva znanstvena tima koji su koristili različite metode za proučavanje raznih dijelova Antarktike. Eric Rignot, glaciolog sa Sveučilišta u Kaliforniji, Irvine, vodio je jedan od timova. Izjavio je da je značajan dio zapadnoantarktičkog ledenog pokrivača ušao u stanje nepovratnog povlačenja. Od ranih 1990-ih, njegov tim je promatrao smanjivanje od 10 do 35 kilometara u nekoliko lednika, koji se također tanjaju. Glavni uzrok topljenja je zagrijavanje zbog povećanja ugljikovog dioksida od sagorijevanja fosilnih goriva. Ozonska rupa, iako nije povezana s plinovima staklenika, možda također igra ulogu pojačavajući vjetrove koji privlače tople vode na površinu, erodirajući led. Dok je porast razine mora uglavnom bio zbog toplinskog širenja morske vode, otopina kopnenog leda uskoro će imati veliki utjecaj. Ian Joughin, vođa drugog istraživačkog tima, potvrdio je da je urušavanje ledene ploče neizbježno, ali će se dogoditi sporo tijekom stoljeća. John H. Mercer sa Državnog sveučilišta Ohio prvi je predvidio ovaj scenarij još 1978. Iako nije doživio da vidi svoja predviđanja, ona sada postaju stvarnost. U međuvremenu, Međuvladin panel o klimatskim promjenama (IPCC) upozorava da bi razina mora mogla porasti čak do 3 stope unutar ovog stoljeća, utječući na mnoge od nas i našu djecu. Članak također ističe trenutne probleme poput poplava u niskim područjima širom svijeta i političke blokade koja sprečava značajno djelovanje protiv klimatskih promjena. Postavlja pitanja o našoj moralnoj odgovornosti prema budućim generacijama i nedostatku napretka u prijelazu na čistu energiju. Unatoč tome što znamo rizike desetljećima, napredka je bilo malo. Tehnologija je napredovala, ali nije široko prihvaćena zbog poricanja, inercije i utjecaja lobiranja velikih energetskih tvrtki. Globalno, nedostaje ujedinjeni napor za stabilizaciju klime i promicanje čiste energije. Članak završava osjećajem rezignacije, sugerirajući da čovječanstvo možda nije sposobno riješiti probleme koje smo stvorili.

article_content: This year’s winners at the Camerimage Film Festival in Toruń, Poland, were unveiled on Saturday, with 'The New Boy', Warwick Thornton’s drama about an indigenous boy taken in at a mysterious remote monastery, taking the top prize. 'Poor Things', Searchlight’s Yorgos Lanthimos drama starring Emma Stone, won the Audience Award at the festival, which focuses on the art of cinematography. Camerimage’s Golden Frog is widely considered an Oscar precursor, with three of the past five Golden Frog winners going on to earn Oscar nominations in cinematography. article_content: Maria Teresa Turrion Borrallo, the newly appointed nanny for Prince George, was once expected to join a convent due to her devout and reserved nature. However, her deep love for caring for children steered her towards a career in childcare. Friends and acquaintances from her hometown of Palencia, Spain, describe her as someone who lived a simple, almost saintly life, earning her the nickname 'Santa.' Borrallo, a graduate of the esteemed Norland College, is known for her dedication and professionalism. Her family, deeply rooted in religious traditions, includes a brother who is an ordained deacon. Maria Teresa herself was thought to follow a similar path, but her passion for children led her to the UK over two decades ago. Despite her quiet demeanor, Borrallo is highly respected in her community. Her mother, still residing in Palencia, expresses immense pride in her daughter's accomplishments. Borrallo's siblings are also successful in their respective fields, with one brother being a renowned music teacher and another working in France. Borrallo's journey from Spain to becoming the royal nanny is a testament to her hard work and dedication. Her background and education make her an ideal candidate for the prestigious role, and her family and community continue to support her wholeheartedly.

Njena obitelj, duboko ukorijenjena u religiozne tradicije, uključuje brata koji je zaređeni đakon. Sama Maria Teresa mislilo se da će slijediti sličan put, ali je njena strast prema djeci dovela je u Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo prije više od dvadeset godina. Unatoč svojem tihom ponašanju, Borrallo je vrlo cijenjena u svojoj zajednici. Njena majka, koja i dalje živi u Palenciji, izražava ogroman ponos zbog postignuća svoje kćeri. Borrallina braća također su uspješna u svojim područjima, s jednim bratom koji je poznati učitelj glazbe i drugim koji radi u Francuskoj. Borrallin put od Španjolske do postajanja kraljevske dadilje svjedočanstvo je njenom marljivom radu i predanosti. Njena pozadina i obrazovanje čine je idealnom kandidatkinjom za tu uglednu ulogu, a njezina obitelj i zajednica i dalje je podržavaju iz srca.

article_content: Experts have revealed that the UK holds enough shale gas to meet its needs for a decade, with reserves estimated at 26 trillion cubic feet (tcf). This figure, reported by America's Energy Information Administration (EIA), is nearly ten times the annual consumption of Britain. Extraction efforts have begun in North West England, with significant reserves also believed to exist in South East England, the Midlands, Central Scotland, and the Welsh border. However, the EIA notes that fracking in the UK has had a rough start, causing two minor earthquakes near Blackpool and facing strong political opposition. Despite these setbacks, the EIA's report highlights the potential for shale oil extraction, estimating reserves at 700 million barrels. Fracking, the process of injecting water and chemicals into rocks to release gas or oil, has seen varied estimates of recoverable volumes. A 2011 EIA study put shale gas resources at 20 tcf, while a 2010 British Geological Survey (BGS) estimate was much lower at 5.3 tcf. Operations near Blackpool were halted in 2011 due to earthquake concerns, leading to an 18-month moratorium. Cuadrilla, the company operating in Lancashire, estimates potential reserves at 200 tcf. Even if only 10% of these reserves are accessible, it could significantly reduce the UK's dependence on foreign imports. Opponents of fracking raise concerns about its safety, potential damage to the countryside, increased traffic, and water pollution from fracking fluids. The EIA acknowledges that fracking is more complex and costly in the UK compared to North America, and commercial viability is yet to be established. The report also notes stronger political opposition in the UK compared to Poland, Europe's leader in shale development. The initial fracking attempts in the UK caused local earthquakes, highlighting the challenges ahead. Fracking involves injecting water, sand, and chemicals into shale rock formations to create fissures, allowing trapped gas to flow and be extracted. The process has been used experimentally since 1947 and commercially since 1949. By 2012, 2.5 million fracking jobs had been performed worldwide.
translated_content: Stručnjaci su otkrili da Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo ima dovoljno škriljevitog plina da zadovolji svoje potrebe za desetljeće, s rezervama koje se procjenjuju na 26 bilijuna kubnih stopa (tcf). Ova brojka, koju je objavila Američka uprava za energetiku (EIA), gotovo je deset puta veća od godišnje potrošnje Velike Britanije. Napori za vađenje su započeli na sjeverozapadu Engleske, a značajne rezerve se također vjeruje da postoje u jugoistočnoj Engleskoj, Midlandsu, središnjoj Škotskoj i na velškoj granici. Međutim, EIA navodi da je frakturiranje u Velikoj Britaniji imalo težak početak, uzrokujući dva manja potresa u blizini Blackpoola i suočavajući se sa snažnim političkim otporom. Usprkos ovim preprekama, izvješće EIA ističe potencijal za vađenje škriljevitog ulja, procijenjujući rezerve na 700 milijuna barela. Frakturiranje, proces ubrizgavanja vode i kemikalija u stijene kako bi se oslobodio plin ili nafta, doživjelo je različite procjene obujma koji se može povratiti. Studija EIA iz 2011. stavila je resurse škriljevitog plina na 20 tcf, dok je procjena Britanskog geološkog zavoda (BGS) iz 2010. bila mnogo niža, 5.3 tcf. Operacije u blizini Blackpoola su zaustavljene 2011. zbog zabrinutosti oko potresa, što je dovelo do 18-mjesečnog moratorija. Cuadrilla, tvrtka koja radi u Lancashireu, procjenjuje potencijalne rezerve na 200 tcf. Čak i ako je samo 10% ovih rezerva dostupno, to bi moglo značajno smanjiti ovisnost Velike Britanije o uvozu. Protivnici frakturiranja izražavaju zabrinutost zbog sigurnosti, potencijalne štete na selu, povećanog prometa i onečišćenja vode frakturirajućim tekućinama. EIA priznaje da je frakturiranje složenije i skuplje u Velikoj Britaniji u usporedbi sa Sjevernom Amerikom, a komercijalna održivost još nije uspostavljena. Izvješće također navodi jači politički otpor u Velikoj Britaniji u usporedbi s Poljskom, vođom Europe u razvoju škriljevitog plina. Prvi pokušaji frakturiranja u Velikoj Britaniji uzrokovali su lokalne potrese, ističući izazove koji su ispred. Frakturiranje uključuje ubrizgavanje vode, pijeska i kemikalija u škriljevite stijenske formacije kako bi se stvorile pukotine, omogućavajući zarobljenom plinu da teče i bude izvađen. Proces se koristi eksperimentalno od 1947. i komercijalno od 1949. Do 2012. izvršeno je 2,5 milijuna poslova frakturiranja širom svijeta.
